summary: Frontend-only testing of the Jam Now Studio app interface feature on the GroovLabz site. All 14 requested checks passed: home hero shows groovsesh phone mockup and links to /apps/groovsesh; home-apps-section has all 5 cards (groovsesh, groovbox, groovmash, groovtrackz, groovcharts) each rendering the app-screen mockup with height=315px; every /apps/:id detail page shows correct name, store buttons with correct hrefs (https://www.apple.com/app-store/ and https://play.google.com/store) and target=_blank; galleries match spec (groovsesh=3 images all loaded with naturalWidth>0, groovmash=1 image loaded, others=none); more-apps section shows 4 cards excluding current and navigates correctly; back link goes to /apps; unknown /apps/doesnotexist redirects to /apps; /apps page has all 5 sections with download-<id>-btn linking to /apps/<id> and app-screen-link-<id>; static assets /jamnow/galaxy-bg.jpg, flying-v.png, groovsesh-home.png return 200; regression pages /instruments, /shop, /login load; account page after admin login renders 'Connect an app' grid and contains all 5 new app ids; mobile 390px shows exactly 2 columns of cards without card overflow. 0 console errors during the entire session.

issues: document.scrollWidth > clientWidth (horizontal overflow present) even though the home-apps-section grid itself fits (2 cols of 169px within 390px). Some other element on the home page is pushing horizontal scroll on mobile. Worth investigating (likely hero decoration or stats row).

action_items: Investigate horizontal overflow on Home page at 390px width (document.documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth). The apps grid is fine; likely candidates are the hero artwork, stats row, or a decorative element.
critical_code_review_comments: Store links are placeholders (apple.com/app-store, play.google.com/store) - acknowledged as intentional in the request.
getApp returns undefined for unknown ids; AppDetail correctly redirects to /apps (verified).
test_credentials: admin@groovlabz.com / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - login successful, account page loaded
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend was intentionally skipped this iteration (see iteration_1.json for the previous full pass). All Jam Now Studio frontend feature acceptance criteria are met. Only outstanding item is a minor mobile horizontal-overflow investigation on Home page (not related to the app-cards grid itself).
